scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
Hey, you're carrying
way too much stuff. Why don't you stash it away in Kafra Storage? We can talk after you do that, right?
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
嘿，你身上带的东西太多了。为什么不把它们存进卡普拉仓库呢？等你办完这件事，我们再聊，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
My name is Jaax.
Without ego, I can
say that I am perhaps the
^663300greatest inventor of our time^000000.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
我叫贾克斯。
毫不自夸地说，我或许是^663300这个时代最伟大的发明家^000000。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
This time, I've
created something
truly extraordinary. I call them... ^663300Magic Quivers^000000 !! This will be remembered in history as an
arrow revolution!
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
这一次，我创造出了真正非凡的东西。我称之为... ^663300魔法箭筒^000000！！这将被载入史册，成为一场箭矢的革命！

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
I've studied magic and quivers for years, working night and day until I finally figured how to condense arrows with magic! With magic quivers, you'll be carrying more arrows, but with less weight!
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
我研究魔法和箭筒多年，夜以继日地工作，终于想出了如何用魔法压缩箭矢的方法！使用魔法箭筒，你可以携带更多的箭矢，但重量却更轻！

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
Would you like to try using one of my arrow quivers? I have no doubt that someone like you can appreciate my genius!
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
你想试试使用我的箭筒吗？我毫不怀疑，像你这样的人一定能欣赏我的天才！

scripts.text: Quiver
scripts.translation: 箭筒

scripts.text: Iron Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 铁箭矢筒

scripts.text: Steel Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 钢铁箭矢筒

scripts.text: Oridecon Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 神之金属箭矢筒

scripts.text: Fire Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 火箭矢筒

scripts.text: Silver Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 银箭矢筒

scripts.text: Wind Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 风灵箭矢筒

scripts.text: Stone Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 地灵箭矢筒

scripts.text: Crystal Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 水灵箭矢筒

scripts.text: Shadow Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 影子箭矢筒

scripts.text: Immaterial Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 无形箭矢筒

scripts.text: Rusty Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 铁锈箭矢筒

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
Excellent!
Are you carrying any Arrows with you? I'll provide you with a quiver that can carry {0} of your {1}s for only ^FF3131{2} Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
太好了！
你身上带着箭矢吗？我可以提供一个箭筒，能装下你{1}中的{0}支，只需^FF3131{2} Zeny^000000。

scripts.text: Store as many Arrows in quivers as possible
scripts.translation: 尽可能多地将箭矢存入箭筒

scripts.text: Purchase 1 quiver
scripts.translation: 购买1个箭筒

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
Number of
Arrows: ^3131FF{0} ^000000
Maximum Number
of Purchasable
Quivers: ^3131FF{1} ^000000
Zeny required: ^3131FF{2} Zeny^000000

[Inventor Jaax]
Would you like to
buy as many Quivers
as you can for the Arrows
you are currently carrying?
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
您想购买尽可能多的箭筒，
来装下您目前携带的箭矢吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
There you go!
Just remember, ^FF0000you won't be able to use the Quiver when your carried weight is 90% of your maximum weight limit^000000.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
给您！
请记住，^FF0000当您的负重达到最大负重限制的90%时，将无法使用箭筒^000000。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
So...
Just keep track
of how much you're
carrying from time
to time and you should
be alright.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
所以...
只要时不时留意一下
您的负重情况，
应该就没问题了。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
I'm sorry, but you don't have enough Zeny. I can't just give these away after working years
to develop this revolutionary technology!
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足。我花了多年时间研发这项革命性技术，
不能就这样白送出去！

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
You changed your mind?
When the glory of owning
a quiver is so close?
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
您改变主意了？
拥有箭筒的荣耀
近在咫尺啊？

scripts.text:

There you go!

scripts.translation:

给您！
请记住，^FF0000当您的负重达到最大负重限制的90%时，将无法使用箭筒^000000。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
You don't even
have {0} Zeny?
I'm so sorry. I had no
idea that you were so...
^333333Destitute^000000.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
您连{0} Zeny都没有吗？
真抱歉。我没想到您会这么...
^333333一贫如洗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
What...?
Do you not see that this invention can forever change the way Arrows are carried?! The future is now!
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
什么...？
您难道没看到这项发明将永远改变箭矢的携带方式吗？！未来已来！

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
You can carry a maximum of {0} Arrows within this quiver. It was made using my secret method,
so the total weight of the Arrows and Quiver is less than carrying the Arrows alone.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
这个箭筒最多可以装{0}支箭矢。它是用我的秘密方法制作的，
因此箭矢和箭筒的总重量比单独携带箭矢更轻。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
It's a miracle of science! One that you can experience for yourself if you bring me at least {0} Arrows and {1} Zeny for each Quiver.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
这是科学的奇迹！如果您带给我至少{0}支箭矢和{1} Zeny，
您就能亲自体验它。
